messages:
Rae (People Ops): Quick manager + HR checklist for Evan's new PM (Sam) starting Mon. Short so IT/HR can action tonight.

Preboard (today):
- Confirm legal name + preferred display name (Evan).
- ID upload to HR portal (Lena).
- Device & badge queued (IT-Bot) 1 confirm courier vs pickup.
- Add Sam to #product, #pm, #new-hires and product docs.
- Create OnboardBot checklist and tag Kai as buddy.

Day 1 (light):
- 09:30: HR admin (Lena, 15m).
- 11:00: Team intros (20m) 1 no slides.
- 13:00: Product walkthrough (Kai).
- 15:00: 1:1 with Evan (30m) 1 set 30d priorities + communication norms.
- Micro task: review last release notes and add 3 suggestions.

Week 1 goals:
- Finish SSO + MFA + security training.
- Shadow one customer demo or support thread.
- Share a 1-page "first impressions" in #product.

30/60/90 prompts (paste into 1:1):
- 30d: Understand users & metrics; own a small spec.
- 60d: Lead a cross-functional experiment.
- 90d: Deliver measurable improvement and propose next steps.

Logistics:
- HR portal: https://hr.redwood.local/onboard (Lena).
- Badge pickup: lobby or courier (IT-Bot).
- Console access request: /forms/console-access (Evan include GitHub handle).

Evan (Eng Manager): Sending intro email now. Kai confirmed buddy slot at 13:00. Please add a day-3 check-in on the checklist.

Rae (People Ops): Done 1 added day-3/day-7 reminders. OnboardBot created OB-1753214321: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-1753214321

IT-Bot: Laptop (14" MBP) imaged. Pickup 09:00 or courier available. Need GitHub handle for team mapping and phone for MFA or we can issue a hardware key.

Kai (Product Buddy): I'll prepare dashboard + backlog walkthrough and a template for the 1-page note.

Lena (HR): Sending HR invite. Sam, please complete tax & benefits forms within 5 business days.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: security training due in 72 hours; HR forms due in 5 days.

Evan (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone. Reply here if anything changes overnight. :thumbsup:
